# A Greek Word

<!-- STEP id="split" -->
The word economics comes from the Greek word **oikonomia**. It joins two words: **oikos**, the household, and **nemein**, management. So economics first meant managing a household.

<!-- STEP id="scale" -->
A family has limited money and many wants, so it plans. A country has limited resources and many wants too, so it must also plan.

**Economics studies how choices are made when limited resources must meet needs and wants.**
